name: HoppyFrogERC
fix_description: In swapTokensForEth, the amountOutMinimum is set to 0, meaning the contract accepts any output amount without validation. Set a reasonable minimum output based on oracle price or TWAP to reject swaps at manipulated prices.
_review_note: DISPUTED: Same pattern as bench-297. amountOutMin=0 sandwich vulnerability. Unclear if input-validation or price-manipulation.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct exploit using a single Uniswap V3 flash loan followed by a few swaps and a token transfer to manipulate a fee-on-transfer/token-specific behavior. It involves limited protocol complexity, few moving parts, and the PoC is well under 100 lines of actual exploit logic.
